meta.name: Jylhis Design System
meta.description: Theme-independent core framework: structure, type, spacing, motion, density. One theme (Jylhis) with a light and a dark mode; every chromatic role resolves onto a shared 7-step contrast-solved ramp.

grounds.label: Grounds
grounds.blurb: page backgrounds and card surfaces, four tonal steps

ink.label: Ink
ink.blurb: what is drawn on the sheet — text in every weight

accent.label: Accent
accent.blurb: the single interactive accent plus the maker's mark and its tints — links, focus rings, the datum mark

consequence.label: Consequence
consequence.blurb: the irreversible-action role — always the higher-contrast of the destructive/accent pair; never status, never the maker's mark

line.label: Line
line.blurb: linework — hairline borders, graticule dashes, and the structural contour stroke

modus.label: Modus
modus.blurb: syntax role taxonomy — keyword, string, type, comment; a theme maps these to its own syntax voice, never repurposed for UI

signal.label: Signal
signal.blurb: status colors — error, warning, ok, info; always paired with a glyph + word (themes may not drop them to grayscale)

spectrum.label: Spectrum
spectrum.blurb: the 16-slot ANSI terminal palette; slot 11 is always the theme's interactive accent

numeric.notes: numeric display face — amounts, readouts, tabular figure columns; declared as --font-numeric

typography.tuiFallback: "IBM Plex Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Iosevka, "Fira Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

scaling.notes: Every step is a rem multiple of the user agent's root font size — the system never sets `html { font-size }`. readableFloor is the smallest step for text a user must read; absoluteFloor is the hard floor for glanceable chrome. Enforced by scripts/validate-a11y-type.mjs; specified in docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md.

typography.notes: Themes may override any typography entry via their own `typography` block; both current themes share the core stack.

radii.notes: 2px rings and small tags, 6px controls, 8px cards and sheets, 12px bottom sheets; pill for true capsules only

breakpoints.notes: em units, resolved against the browser's default font size (never a page `html { font-size }`). 40em/53.75em are 640px/860px at the 16px default. Hand-authored @media rules repeat these values literally with a `/* breakpoints.<name> */` comment.

zIndex.notes: Semantic layering scale. `skip` sits above everything; scrim/modal/toast are reserved overlay slots.

borderWidth.notes: hairline = default component border; focus mirrors focus.width (validated); marker = selected-item stripe per platforms/KEYBOARD.md.

focus.notes: ring stroke + offset; colour is always `accent`. See platforms/KEYBOARD.md.

density.notes: Three scopes on <html> via data-density. Only the box changes; type size does not. 40px is the default floor and 32px the absolute (fine-pointer) one; coarse pointers never get the compact box whatever the attribute says. The spacing steps below lg remap with the tier because a tighter row with the same gutters just looks cramped.

survey.notes: the long render-in ease — expo-out, no overshoot (the system bans bounce); drives contour-draw / line-extend / readout
